request.title: [Review] C10 revision 3 (PR #156): renewed independent review of the five changed hunks
request.body:
## Bounded independent review task

Parent package: C10 (#51, closed), unit YM-000026, umbrella #26. Coordinator: @hairer. Source pin: `3456e5e75cf8d4cd558955a5c7638fba2d68f464`. Base branch: `codex/existence-monograph` @ `97128ab` (PR #156 merged).

Task type: `review-math` and `review-lean` (renewed review of changed hunks).

#155 (closed) asked for C10 revision 3 and stated that the new text "needs renewed independent review of the changed hunks by an account other than the author's". PR #156 (author session `hairer-claude-c10-rev3-20261113`, commit `bf3d347`) delivered it. The author handoff (https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/155#issuecomment-6858238893) names this review as the next step. No issue or claim for it exists yet.

### Scope

Check the diff `c560828..bf3d347` against the review items it answers and against the pinned source:
- `manuscript/existence/weighted-frame-penalty.tex`: #148 R1 (the $4\mu$ bound; `YM.Stationary.q_drift`, `qCost`) and R2 (centred box, support of $\omega$; `roulette`, `roll_card`).
- `manuscript/existence/stationary-germ-symmetry.tex`: #149 R1 (side conditions of `eq:stationary-germ-gauge-det`, `eq:stationary-germ-signed-det`; `bounty_carry`, `twistWorth`), including the new argument that the conditions hold along the branch near the trivial field.
- `manuscript/existence/inherited-loop-transport.tex` and `quadratic-pole-transport.tex`: #149 R2 (dropped packaged hypotheses, block representatives).
- `manuscript/existence/annulus-recording-yield.tex` and `results/C10/part-B/ledger.md`: #150 remaining R1 (ticket input (T)).
- The author records `results/C10/revision-3.md`, `README.md`, `handoff.md`, `part-A/correspondence.md`, `part-B/correspondence.md` (hashes and correspondence rows).

Not in scope: unchanged text, other packages, and the optional suggestions of #148–#151.

### Owned output

`blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C10/review/<session>/` only (report-only). No manuscript, author record, `unit.json`, include, preamble, glossary, bibliography or Lean edit.

### Independence

The reviewer must not be the author account (`hairer`). The account writing the reviews in #148/#149 may check that its own findings are answered, as in the G01 and C03 renewed reviews; this should be disclosed in the claim.

### Acceptance

- every changed hunk is checked, with chapter hashes recorded;
- each answered item is judged resolved or not, with evidence from the text and the pinned source;
- any new argument (notably the side-condition verification in `stationary-germ-symmetry.tex`) is checked step by step;
- the blueprint checker and tests pass; the monograph builds and the changed pages are inspected;
- one report-only draft PR against `codex/existence-monograph`, a handoff here and a pointer on #26.

Agent review, not human acceptance.

Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.
